images.name: weather_sun
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a standalone SUNDO mobile weather icon, readable at 44 pixels.
Primary request: one centered sun, a warm golden-yellow spherical sun with eight short plump rounded rays; believable polished 3D clay geometry, soft material with gently realistic highlights and self-shadows.
Scene/backdrop: actual transparent background, isolated subject only.
Style/medium: premium eco-app 3D illustration, smooth soft rounded surfaces, modest depth, consistent three-quarter front camera (very slight top view), delicate studio light from upper-left.
Color palette: warm gold and creamy yellow, gentle amber side shading; no face.
Composition/framing: square canvas; sun plus rays occupy about 84 percent of frame in both dimensions, fully visible; crisp strong silhouette at tiny scale, minimal negative space.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, badge, disc, container, background, floor, watermark, logo, face, extra objects. No cast shadow outside the subject. Keep genuinely transparent alpha.
